kv18.6:2.3: Yā paṭhamassa jhānassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā --pe-- paṇidhi, sā va dutiyassa jhānassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā -- pe -- paṇidhīti?
kv18.6:3.1: Paṭhamā jhānā dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ saṃkamati, na vattabbaṃ
kv18.6:3.2: "Yā paṭhamassa jhānassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā -- pe -- paṇidhi, sā va dutiyassa jhānassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā --pe-- paṇidhīti"?
kv18.6:3.4: Dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ anāvaṭṭantassa uppajjati --pe-- apaṇidahantassa uppajjatīti?
kv18.6:3.6: Nanu dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ āvaṭṭantassa uppajjati --pe-- paṇidahantassa uppajjatīti?
kv18.6:3.8: Hañci dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ āvaṭṭantassa uppajjati --pe-- paṇidahantassa uppajjati, no vata re vattabbe
kv18.6:4.3: Paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ kāme ādīnavato manasikaroto uppajjatīti?
kv18.6:4.5: Dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ kāme ādīnavato manasikaroto uppajjatīti?
kv18.6:5.7: Tañ ñeva paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ taṃ dutiyaṃ jhānan ti?
kv18.6:6.3: Yā dutiyassa jhānassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā --pe-- paṇidhi, sā va tatiyassa jhānassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā -- pe -- paṇidhīti?
kv18.6:7.1: Dutiyā jhānā tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ saṃkamati, na vattabbaṃ
kv18.6:7.2: "Yā dutiyassa jhānassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā -- pe -- paṇidhi, sā va tatiyassa jhānassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā --pe-- paṇidhīti"?
kv18.6:7.4: Tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ anāvaṭṭantassa uppajjati --pe-- apaṇidahantassa uppajjatīti?
kv18.6:7.6: Nanu tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ āvaṭṭantassa uppajjati --pe-- paṇidahantassa uppajjatīti?
kv18.6:7.8: Hañci tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ āvaṭṭantassa uppajjati --pe-- paṇidahantassa uppajjati, no vata re vattabbe
kv18.6:8.3: Dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ vitakkavicāre ādīnavato manasikaroto uppajjatīti?
kv18.6:8.5: Tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ vitakkavicāre ādīnavato manasikaroto uppajjatīti?
kv18.6:9.7: Tañ ñeva dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ taṃ tatiyaṃ jhānan ti?
kv18.6:10.3: Yā tatiyassa jhānassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā --pe-- paṇidhi, sā va catutthassa jhānassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā -- pe -- paṇidhīti?
kv18.6:11.1: Tatiyā jhānā catutthaṃ jhānaṃ saṃkamati, na vattabbaṃ
kv18.6:11.2: "Yā tatiyassa jhānassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā --pe-- paṇidhi, sā va catutthassa jhānassa uppādāya āvaṭṭanā -- pe -- paṇidhīti"?
kv18.6:11.4: Catutthaṃ jhānaṃ anāvaṭṭantassa uppajjati --pe-- apaṇidahantassa uppajjatīti?
kv18.6:11.6: Nanu catutthaṃ jhānaṃ āvaṭṭantassa uppajjati --pe-- paṇidahantassa uppajjatīti?
kv18.6:11.8: Hañci catutthaṃ jhānaṃ āvaṭṭantassa uppajjati --pe-- paṇidahantassa uppajjati, no vata re vattabbe
kv18.6:12.3: Tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ pītiṃ ādīnavato manasikaroto uppajjatīti?
kv18.6:12.5: Catutthaṃ jhānaṃ pītiṃ ādīnavato manasikaroto uppajjatīti?
kv18.6:13.7: Tañ ñeva tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ taṃ catutthaṃ jhānan ti?
